signed_rows.behavior: A concept whose stale_after has passed is due with that reason.
signed_rows.fails_when: the concept is not listed, or its reason is not stale_after

signed_rows.behavior: A concept with no verified entry is due with that reason.
signed_rows.fails_when: the concept is not listed, or its reason is not unverified

signed_rows.behavior: A concept is due when a tracked source file changed in git after its last verified date, for bundle-root, concept-relative, repository-root and concept-id sources.
signed_rows.fails_when: any of the four forms, changed after verification, is not reported, or is reported when unchanged

signed_rows.behavior: URLs are skipped, and a source that resolves to no tracked file is listed as a source-not-resolved notice, not as a due reason.
signed_rows.fails_when: a URL is reported, or a free-text source makes the concept due

signed_rows.behavior: Handoffs are left out of the concept checks, and an expired handoff is listed once, under expired handoffs.
signed_rows.fails_when: a live handoff is due for lacking verified, or an expired one appears twice

signed_rows.behavior: In a shallow clone the history reason is skipped and the output says so.
signed_rows.fails_when: a shallow clone reports a source-changed reason, or the output does not say the reason was skipped

signed_rows.behavior: It exits 0 whether or not anything is due, and --json prints the same result as one object.
signed_rows.fails_when: the exit code is nonzero when concepts are due, or --json output is not one object with due, notices and expired handoffs
